🎥🌿: Jungle (2017)

Seeking adventure and a deeper connection with the world, Yossi Ghinsberg travels to Bolivia, where he joins fellow travelers Kevin and Marcus on an expedition into the Amazon rainforest led by mysterious guide Karl. What begins as an exciting journey into untouched wilderness soon becomes increasingly dangerous as tensions rise and the group begins to separate.

After circumstances leave Yossi stranded alone in the jungle, he must survive with limited supplies while facing hunger, exhaustion, dangerous wildlife, and the unforgiving environment. With every passing day, his hope of finding civilization—or being rescued—begins to fade.

Based on a true story, Jungle follows one man’s extraordinary struggle for survival as determination, friendship, and the will to make it home are pushed to their limits deep inside the Amazon.
